# Law360 highlights how law firms are innovating with new funding models


- Law firm equity


October 16, 2025


-
-
-
-


Law360 reports on how law firms are innovating their funding of business operations. On a panel in Chicago, Vice Chair[David Perla](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/david-perla/) said that since law firms need more capital than they can raise from their partners to acquire talent and technology, "\[o\]utside capital is finding its way into law firms through channels such as marketing and back offices."


[Read the full article here.](https://www.law360.com/pulse/daily-litigation/articles/2400458/law-firms-using-creative-ways-to-fund-operations)
